verdict.rationale: Recruitee is a SaaS applicant-tracking system that markets 'AI & Automation' features, so an AI-training opt-out is a fair question to ask of it. The evidence pack contains no documentation of any setting, policy, or contractual commitment that keeps customer or candidate data out of AI model training. The audit-log, API and webhook material is about other capabilities and does not address this story.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
